notes: VAG 1.6 TDI common-rail (Infineon TriCore). Diagnostics over CAN (ISO 15765-4, UDS); a complete original typically needs a bench/boot read, while calibration flashing can be done over OBD. Addresses and flash_size are family placeholders and must be confirmed per software variant before any read or write.

maps.name: boost pressure target (role inferred) A1 of 12
maps.notes: CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM. Location/shape DIFF-CONFIRMED: a reference stock/tuned pair changed this 20x16 table (one of 12 back-to-back at 0x1BF318 + k*0x280). Role INFERRED from shape: every row starts at a constant floor (raw 12060) at the low-load end and rises to a load/speed-dependent peak (~2.4x the floor), the profile of an absolute boost-pressure setpoint whose floor is ambient; the tune raised the mid/high-load cells. Physical scale unconfirmed (if the floor is ~1000 hPa the LSB would be ~0.083 hPa - NOT assumed). Byte offsets into the 2 MiB read of software CASM2K30 (03L906023A); the populated area is 0x180000..0x1FFFFF. Simos PCR2.1 stores axes separately from the table data (count-prefixed breakpoint arrays around 0x1A2000..0x1A6FFF) and the table-to-axis binding is in code, so NO axes are shipped and cells are RAW little-endian u16 (scaling not confirmed). Other software (e.g. CASM2L95, 03L906023S/MK) keeps many of these tables byte-identical but at different offsets - locate them by content in your own read before any write.
